answer: A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The hollow counter is kept in plume and lotus shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2511 identities would post 2047 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
